mission.title: Cracking the Egg
mission.description: Lead an assault team to recover the key from Silver's construct.

phase.briefing:
This Exile, Silver, believes that he can hide the key from us in a construct. He should know better. As you and I speak, our technicians are working to break the security code protecting this construct.
Please proceed to the technical installation. You will be there when the construct is... broken, and lead the assault team to recover the key.

enter.say: Okay, you'd better find Wezen. He's the contact for the team you'll be leading.

talk.say: {player}! Soon as the eggheads finish up, we'll be ready to--

done.say:
Operative, I am receiving an urgent communication. The key has been detected back in the Matrix.
Your presence is needed elsewhere. Leave Wezen's team there; they will only slow you down.

phase.briefing:
The key's code signature is being picked up somewhere in Camon Heights. It must have just exited the construct.
End this chase now, {player}. Proceed to the indicated location and intercept the key before it moves on.

enter.say: Hm, looks pretty quiet. Still better keep your eyes open, but don't get your expectations up.

objective.text: Search the area for the key

done.say: Just like I thought, empty. You can get out of there.

phase.briefing: Our tracking device has picked up the key again nearby. Proceed there as quickly as possible to intercept the key before... outside elements can interfere.

enter.say: Hey, looks like we got a live one! Get in there and nab the key, quick!
Commandos?! So the General wants to tangle with us? Take 'em out, {player}.

done.say: No key on site, of course. Might as well clear out of there.

phase.briefing: We are facing strong resistance much earlier than expected. Wezen and his team will meet you at the indicated rendezvous point.

enter.say: Pick up the team and get out of there, fast. We need to punch through this resistance and get to the key!

talk.say: We're ready, {player}. Ready to take out some of those paramilitary freaks!

objective.text: Lead Wezen's team out of the area

phase.briefing:
Bring your team to the indicated location. The key's signal has been detected there, and our surveillance indicates recent activity of both Silver's operatives and the General's men.
Kill all hostiles, both Exiles and commandos. Recover the key. It is of the utmost importance to keep it out of the wrong hands.

enter.say: I'm reading a whole crowd of bad guys in there, {player}. Take care in there!

done.say: No key... better get out of there and face the music.

mission.finish:
Intelligence indicates that the key is now in Zion's possession.
This interference by the General is unacceptable; however, the Truce and cooperation with the redpills of Zion is important to us.
Remain in contact, {player}. This situation warrants extensive analysis and threat evaluation. A decision will be forthcoming.
